name: Dancing Lion (Gold)
description: Lion dance, a traditional lion dance, is popular in the Lingnan area. During festive festivals or major events, lion dance is often performed to add to the fun. Picking green is the essence of lion awakening. People hang "auspicious items" in high places, and the lion awakens to pick them, which represents a wealth of money and a house full of gold and jade. Generally, there will be two or more lions awake, which means good things come in pairs and happy events continue. On May 20, 2006, lion dance was included in the first batch of national intangible cultural heritage lists. The lion awakening puzzle inherits the essence of culture and conveys good wishes to you.
